mir.text: Kaervek sails to the Chaza Isles to investigate an energy surge and there meets Mangara and Jolrael.
Resenting the peace Mangara brokers among the nations of Jamuraa, he persuades Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, and the two ambush Mangara and seal him in an Amber Prison.
With Mangara gone, Kaervek declares war, the nations of Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata unite against him, and he summons the Spirit of the Night, which slaughters the Council of Voices in Tulumai.
Jolrael learns the truth and attacks him at sea, Teferi sinks Kaervek's armada, and Mangara is freed, defeats him and locks him in the Amber Prison.

vis.text: Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, and Mangara later confronts his arrogance, while Kaervek keeps tainting Jamuraa out of spite.
He argues that to kill the land is to destroy the future and says he does not care whether he rules the dead rather than the living.
In the Mirage War his armies cripple Ufunguo, but a magical trap destroys Tefemburu and his armies, and when he sails to Teferi's Isle, Teferi destroys his armada and Jolrael turns on him.
